text:
- **Owner questions:** Ask-tool questions now get answers on the site as well as in chat, and the first answer wins.
- **Tooling and releases:** This repo now runs the new pm release, and its service restarted on it. pm no longer installs a git hook, and Claude sessions here skip auto memory.
- **CI and checks:** Pull requests grade AGENTS.md in diff mode, and the check gives the same verdict on reruns. The macOS Go jobs now run once a day, not on every pull request.
- **Record layer:** The record layer design is agreed: the owner chose Model A. Work started on the published view and per-version pages.
